title: 政策 — policy; CL:個|个[ge4]
summary: A short passage about policy; CL:個|个[ge4].
summary_en: A short passage about policy; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.text: 如果政策只停留在口号上，就不可能真正结果。
paragraphs.hanzi: 如果政策只停留在口号上，就不可能真正结果。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ zhèng cè zhǐ tíng liú zài kǒu hào shàng ， jiù bù kě néng zhēn zhèng jié guǒ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄓˇ ㄊㄧㄥˊ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄎㄡˇ ㄏㄠˋ ㄕㄤˋ ， ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Rúguǒ zhèngcè zhǐ tíngliú zài kǒuhào shàng, jiù bù kěnéng zhēnzhèng jiēguǒ.
paragraphs.translation: If the policy remains only a slogan, it cannot truly produce results.
paragraphs.translation_en: If the policy remains only a slogan, it cannot truly produce results.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika kebijakan hanya sebatas slogan, maka kebijakan tersebut tidak akan benar-benar membuahkan hasil.

paragraphs.text: 这项政策的目的，是降低老百姓的生活成本。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这项政策的目的，是降低老百姓的生活成本。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiàng zhèng cè de mù dì ， shì jiàng dī lǎo bǎi xìng de shēng huó chéng běn 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄇㄨˋ ㄉㄧˋ ， ㄕˋ ㄐㄧㄤˋ ㄉㄧ ㄌㄠˇ ㄅㄞˇ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de mùdì, shì jiàngdī lǎobǎixìng de shēnghuó chéngběn.
paragraphs.translation: The purpose of this policy is to reduce the living costs of ordinary people.
paragraphs.translation_en: The purpose of this policy is to reduce the living costs of ordinary people.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tujuan dari kebijakan ini adalah untuk mengurangi biaya hidup masyarakat awam.

paragraphs.text: 新政策面向广大居民，特别是低收入家庭。
paragraphs.hanzi: 新政策面向广大居民，特别是低收入家庭。
paragraphs.pinyin: xīn zhèng cè miàn xiàng guǎng dà jū mín ， tè bié shì dī shōu rù jiā tíng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄍㄨㄤˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄩ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ， ㄊㄜˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄕˋ ㄉㄧ ㄕㄡ ㄖㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄊㄧㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Xīn zhèngcè miànxiàng guǎngdà jūmín, tèbié shì dī shōurù jiātíng.
paragraphs.translation: The new policy is aimed at a wide range of residents, especially low-income families.
paragraphs.translation_en: The new policy is aimed at a wide range of residents, especially low-income families.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kebijakan baru ini ditujukan kepada berbagai kalangan penduduk, terutama keluarga berpenghasilan rendah.

paragraphs.text: 这项政策由中央批准后，各地才开始推行。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这项政策由中央批准后，各地才开始推行。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiàng zhèng cè yóu zhōng yāng pī zhǔn hòu ， gè dì cái kāi shǐ tuī xíng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄧㄤ ㄆㄧ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄍㄜˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄘㄞˊ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄊㄨㄟ ㄒㄧㄥˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè yóu zhōngyāng pīzhǔn hòu, gèdì cái kāishǐ tuīxíng.
paragraphs.translation: Only after this policy was approved by the central authorities did local areas begin to implement it.
paragraphs.translation_en: Only after this policy was approved by the central authorities did local areas begin to implement it.
paragraphs.translation_id: Baru setelah kebijakan ini disetujui oleh pemerintah pusat, daerah-daerah setempat mulai menerapkannya.

paragraphs.text: 如果没有配套政策，改革很难真正落地。
paragraphs.hanzi: 如果没有配套政策，改革很难真正落地。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ méi yǒu pèi tào zhèng cè ， gǎi gé hěn nán zhēn zhèng luò dì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄆㄟˋ ㄊㄠˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ， ㄍㄞˇ ㄍㄜˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄋㄢˊ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄌㄨㄛˋ ㄉㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Rúguǒ méiyǒu pèitào zhèngcè, gǎigé hěn nán zhēnzhèng luòdì.
paragraphs.translation: Without supporting policies, the reform will be difficult to implement in practice.
paragraphs.translation_en: Without supporting policies, the reform will be difficult to implement in practice.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tanpa kebijakan yang mendukung, reformasi akan sulit diterapkan dalam praktiknya.

paragraphs.text: 他把政策研究得很透，所以回答问题时特别有把握。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他把政策研究得很透，所以回答问题时特别有把握。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā bǎ zhèng cè yán jiū dé hěn tòu ， suǒ yǐ huí dá wèn tí shí tè bié yǒu bǎ wò 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄅㄚˇ ㄓㄥˋ ㄘㄜˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄉㄜˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄊㄡˋ ， ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧˇ ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄉㄚˊ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄕˊ ㄊㄜˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄨㄛˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā bǎ zhèngcè yánjiū de hěn tòu, suǒyǐ huídá wèntí shí tèbié yǒu bǎwò.
paragraphs.translation: He has studied the policy very thoroughly, so he is especially confident when answering questions.
paragraphs.translation_en: He has studied the policy very thoroughly, so he is especially confident when answering questions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia telah mempelajari kebijakan tersebut dengan sangat teliti, jadi dia sangat percaya diri saat menjawab pertanyaan.

title: 不得 — must not, cannot
title_id: 不得 — tidak boleh, tidak bisa
summary: A short passage about must not, cannot.
summary_en: A short passage about must not, cannot.
summary_id: Bacaan singkat tentang tidak boleh, tidak bisa.

paragraphs.text: 这件旧衣服陪伴了他很久，他舍不得扔掉。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这件旧衣服陪伴了他很久，他舍不得扔掉。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè jiàn jiù yī fú péi bàn le tā hěn jiǔ ， tā shě bù dé rēng diào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧ ㄈㄨˊ ㄆㄟˊ ㄅㄢˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄊㄚ ㄏㄣˇ ㄐㄧㄡˇ ， ㄊㄚ ㄕㄜˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄖㄥ ㄉㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè jiàn jiù yīfu péibàn le tā hěn jiǔ, tā shěbude rēngdiào.
paragraphs.translation: This old piece of clothing had accompanied him for a long time, so he was reluctant to throw it away.
paragraphs.translation_en: This old piece of clothing had accompanied him for a long time, so he was reluctant to throw it away.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pakaian tua itu sudah lama menemaninya, sehingga ia enggan membuangnya.

paragraphs.text: 这份手稿为何被长期封存，至今仍不得而知。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这份手稿为何被长期封存，至今仍不得而知。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè fèn shǒu gǎo wèi hé bèi cháng qī fēng cún ， zhì jīn réng bù dé ér zhī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄍㄠˇ ㄨㄟˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄅㄟˋ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄈㄥ ㄘㄨㄣˊ ， ㄓˋ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄖㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄦˊ ㄓ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè fèn shǒugǎo wèihé bèi chángqī fēngcún, zhìjīn réng bùdé'érzhī.
paragraphs.translation: Why this manuscript was sealed away for so long remains unknown to this day.
paragraphs.translation_en: Why this manuscript was sealed away for so long remains unknown to this day.
paragraphs.translation_id: Mengapa naskah ini disegel begitu lama masih belum diketahui hingga saat ini.

paragraphs.text: 这个地区常年缺水，居民不得不依靠地下水和外地供水。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这个地区常年缺水，居民不得不依靠地下水和外地供水。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè ge dì qū cháng nián quē shuǐ ， jū mín bù dé bù yī kào dì xià shuǐ hé wài dì gōng shuǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˋ ㄑㄩ ㄔㄤˊ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄑㄩㄝ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ， ㄐㄩ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧ ㄎㄠˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄨㄞˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄕㄨㄟˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhège dìqū chángnián quēshuǐ, jūmín bùdébù yīkào dìxiàshuǐ hé wàidì gōngshuǐ.
paragraphs.translation: This region lacks water all year round, so residents have to rely on groundwater and water supplied from elsewhere.
paragraphs.translation_en: This region lacks water all year round, so residents have to rely on groundwater and water supplied from elsewhere.
paragraphs.translation_id: Daerah ini mengalami kekurangan air sepanjang tahun, sehingga penduduknya harus mengandalkan air tanah dan pasokan air dari tempat lain.

paragraphs.text: 为了控制成本，公司不得不砍掉几个低效项目。
paragraphs.hanzi: 为了控制成本，公司不得不砍掉几个低效项目。
paragraphs.pinyin: wèi le kòng zhì chéng běn ， gōng sī bù dé bù kǎn diào jǐ gè dī xiào xiàng mù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄎㄨㄥˋ ㄓˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ， ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄎㄢˇ ㄉㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄉㄧ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄇㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Wèile kòngzhì chéngběn, gōngsī bùdébù kǎn diào jǐ gè dīxiào xiàngmù.
paragraphs.translation: To control costs, the company had to cut several inefficient projects.
paragraphs.translation_en: To control costs, the company had to cut several inefficient projects.
paragraphs.translation_id: Untuk mengendalikan biaya, perusahaan harus memangkas beberapa proyek yang tidak efisien.

paragraphs.text: 部分文物未经批准不得出境，以防珍贵资料流失。
paragraphs.hanzi: 部分文物未经批准不得出境，以防珍贵资料流失。
paragraphs.pinyin: bù fèn wén wù wèi jīng pī zhǔn bù dé chū jìng ， yǐ fáng zhēn guì zī liào liú shī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄨㄣˊ ㄨˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄐㄧㄥ ㄆㄧ ㄓㄨㄣˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄔㄨ ㄐㄧㄥˋ ， ㄧˇ ㄈㄤˊ ㄓㄣ ㄍㄨㄟˋ ㄗ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄧㄡˊ ㄕ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Bùfen wénwù wèi jīng pīzhǔn bùdé chūjìng, yǐ fáng zhēnguì zīliào liúshī.
paragraphs.translation: Some cultural relics may not leave the country without approval, in order to prevent the loss of precious materials.
paragraphs.translation_en: Some cultural relics may not leave the country without approval, in order to prevent the loss of precious materials.
paragraphs.translation_id: Beberapa peninggalan budaya tidak boleh meninggalkan negara tersebut tanpa izin, untuk mencegah hilangnya bahan berharga.

paragraphs.text: 由于成本上升，整个工程不得不推迟三个月。
paragraphs.hanzi: 由于成本上升，整个工程不得不推迟三个月。
paragraphs.pinyin: yóu yú chéng běn shàng shēng ， zhěng gè gōng chéng bù dé bù tuī chí sān gè yuè 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄧㄡˊ ㄩˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄕㄥ ， ㄓㄥˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄨㄟ ㄔˊ ㄙㄢ ㄍㄜˋ ㄩㄝˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, zhěnggè gōngchéng bùdébù tuīchí sān gè yuè.
paragraphs.translation: Because costs rose, the whole project had to be delayed by three months.
paragraphs.translation_en: Because costs rose, the whole project had to be delayed by three months.
paragraphs.translation_id: Karena biaya yang meningkat, seluruh proyek terpaksa ditunda selama tiga bulan.

title: 救援 — rescue, relief
summary: A short passage about rescue, relief.
summary_en: A short passage about rescue, relief.

paragraphs.text: 救援人员通过手机信号定位被困游客的大致位置。
paragraphs.hanzi: 救援人员通过手机信号定位被困游客的大致位置。
paragraphs.pinyin: jiù yuán rén yuán tōng guò shǒu jī xìn hào dìng wèi bèi kùn yóu kè de dà zhì wèi zhì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄐㄧ ㄒㄧㄣˋ ㄏㄠˋ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄅㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄎㄜˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄚˋ ㄓˋ ㄨㄟˋ ㄓˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Jiùyuán rényuán tōngguò shǒujī xìnhào dìngwèi bèikùn yóukè de dàzhì wèizhi.
paragraphs.translation: Rescuers located the approximate position of the trapped tourists through mobile phone signals.
paragraphs.translation_en: Rescuers located the approximate position of the trapped tourists through mobile phone signals.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tim penyelamat menemukan perkiraan posisi wisatawan yang terjebak melalui sinyal telepon seluler.

paragraphs.text: 救援队租用了一艘小船，把物资送到被困的岛上。
paragraphs.hanzi: 救援队租用了一艘小船，把物资送到被困的岛上。
paragraphs.pinyin: jiù yuán duì zū yòng le yī sōu xiǎo chuán ， bǎ wù zī sòng dào bèi kùn de dǎo shàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄗㄨ ㄩㄥˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄧ ㄙㄡ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄔㄨㄢˊ ， ㄅㄚˇ ㄨˋ ㄗ ㄙㄨㄥˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄅㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄠˇ ㄕㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Jiùyuán duì zūyòng le yì sōu xiǎochuán, bǎ wùzī sòng dào bèi kùn de dǎo shàng.
paragraphs.translation: The rescue team hired a small boat to deliver supplies to the stranded island.
paragraphs.translation_en: The rescue team hired a small boat to deliver supplies to the stranded island.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tim penyelamat menyewa perahu kecil untuk mengantarkan perbekalan ke pulau yang terdampar tersebut.
